args.text: Can you pull together every site on Marrow Agrisupply you can find across #central-team? List each with where it comes from. Need it before the customer call.

Hi Pree, here are the Marrow Agrisupply sites I found in #central-team. There aren't many:

1. *Eastbank*: Hollis, 9 Jun 2026, 10:46 AM. Ticket PD-4821 has Eastbank's receiving-door import attached. The file labels the doors E1/E2, but Eastbank's booking sheet uses 01/02, and that needs sorting out before anyone reimports.
2. *Pine Crossing*: you, 9 Jun 2026, 10:48 AM. The morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen. A driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he'd check the shift template.
3. *Wichita store* (probably Marrow, but check): you, 2 Jul 2025, 9:21 AM. You mentioned an 8am check-in with the Wichita store dispatcher while the Marrow Agrisupply office-hours room was open. The message doesn't actually say Wichita is a Marrow store, so I'm inferring that.

Things I left out:
• The 9 Jun escalation also mentioned three rows on the rollout tracker that just say "waiting", but no store names. The tracker itself was only shared as a screenshot, and I can't see it.
• The Tulsa hub (2 Jul 2025) belongs to Tansley Parcel, not Marrow.
• A workspace note puts a "Salina North yard" on *Marrow Fieldworks*, which is a different account, and that note isn't from #central-team.

Your own store-by-store list from the 9 Jun calls never got posted in the channel, so it may have sites I haven't covered.
